internet.reason: WMS background maps from the servers an admin configures

servers.title: Servers
servers.description: The WMS servers. Each has a name, the address for WMS requests, the WMS version and a timeout. The settings reach every browser: no user names or passwords.

x-emc2.hint: The WMS servers; no user names or passwords, the settings reach every browser

id.title: Id
id.description: Lower case letters, digits and '-', unique.

x-emc2.hint: Made from the name; the backgrounds name the server by it

name.title: Name
name.description: The server's name, as the backgrounds' form lists it.

url.title: Address
url.description: The server's http or https address for WMS requests, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8280/geoserver/ows. It may hold a query such as ?map=...; no user name or password.

x-emc2.hint: An http or https address, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8280/geoserver/ows

version.title: WMS version
version.description: The WMS version the server is asked in.

timeoutSeconds.title: Request timeout
timeoutSeconds.description: How long one call to the server may take.

x-emc2.hint: How long one call to the server may take

backgrounds.title: Backgrounds
backgrounds.description: The background maps: one server, one or more of its layers in drawing order (bottom first), and a name.

x-emc2.hint: A background is one server, some of its layers (bottom first) and a name

groups.label: Image
groups.description: How the server's images are fetched and drawn.

id.title: Id
id.description: Lower case letters, digits and '-', unique.

x-emc2.hint: Made from the name; the map view's choice is kept by it

name.title: Name
name.description: The background's name, as the map view offers it.

server.title: Server
server.description: The id of one of the servers.

layers.title: Layers
layers.description: The server's layer names, bottom first (the order WMS draws LAYERS in).

x-emc2.hint: Layer names, bottom first; the panel lists the server's layers

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: tiles (a grid of images) or image (one image per view).

format.title: Image format
format.description: The image format asked of the server: PNG, which can be transparent, or JPEG.

attribution.title: Attribution
attribution.description: The credit the map's owner asks for, always shown with the background.

url.title: Link
url.description: An http or https address the text links to; empty: no link.
